title: 2401. Longest Nice Subarray

examples.explanation: The longest nice subarray is [3,8,48]. This subarray satisfies the conditions: - 3 AND 8 = 0. - 3 AND 48 = 0. - 8 AND 48 = 0. It can be proven that no longer nice subarray can be obtained, so we return 3.
The length of the longest nice subarray is 1. Any subarray of length 1 can be chosen.

hints: What is the maximum possible length of a nice subarray?
If two numbers have bitwise AND equal to zero, they do not have any common set bit. A number x <= 109 only has 30 bits, hence the length of the longest nice subarray cannot exceed 30.
